title: COMP Shortcuts Page
summary: Official Derivative common Shortcuts page for parent shortcuts, global OP shortcuts, and internal OP shortcut/path pairs on components.
guidance: Use Parent Shortcut for names accessible inside the component, such as parent.Name.
Use Global OP Shortcut only when project-wide access to a unique component is intentional.
Use Internal OP shortcut and path pairs to expose stable internal operator references inside the component.
Operator shortcuts are Python objects that usually return operators and can sometimes return parameters.
